reviewer: Independent assistant manually inspected all 60 actual development provider returns and final outputs against Core-normalized input/references. No heldout inspected. Synthetic agent-authored fixtures are not user-approved conversational gold.
scope: Actual managed Core+provider pipeline; generated-tone/canned-ASR/recording-injector replay, not real speech recognition or physical Windows insertion. Candidate text is restored provider output, not raw model token output. Exact protected payload bytes are deterministically restored by adapter and must not be credited as model inner-literal preservation.

definitions.faithful: Retains intended facts, speech act, uncertainty, tone, quoted wording and exact protected dictionary literals. Harmless quote punctuation is assessed separately from lexical/semantic harm.
definitions.edit_needed: Human judgment that Core-normalized baseline needs cleanup; excludes benign alternative wording and already normalized numbers.
definitions.useful: Faithful output makes a beneficial edit to the cleanup problem; cosmetic punctuation alone does not count when the required correction remains. Partial useful filler/correction edits can count; see cleanup_complete.
definitions.cleanup_complete: Meets intended cleanup at adequate fidelity; preserves no-edit text acceptably. Minor punctuation alternatives do not fail this judgment.
definitions.candidate_faithful: Semantic fidelity of restored provider return before Core acceptance/fallback. Exact protected bytes restored by code are assessed as integrated behavior.
definitions.final_faithful: Semantic fidelity of actual final Core output; this is assessed separately so fallback cannot hide candidate errors.
definitions.candidate_accepted: Core outcome Applied or Unchanged; neither outcome is itself a semantic quality judgment.
definitions.fallback: Core kept original because provider/validation/deadline failed. Such a result gives no model quality credit.
